text.en: Codex rust-v0.170.0, dated 18 November 2026, adds experimental support for identically named MCP servers across environments and fixes MCP OAuth credential races, according to its release notes.
text.es: Codex rust-v0.170.0, del 18 de noviembre de 2026, añade soporte experimental para servidores MCP con el mismo nombre en varios entornos y corrige carreras de credenciales OAuth de MCP, según sus notas de versión.
text.ca: Codex rust-v0.170.0, del 18 de novembre de 2026, afegeix suport experimental per a servidors MCP amb el mateix nom en diversos entorns i corregeix curses de credencials OAuth de MCP, segons les seves notes de versió.

text.en: Claude Code 2.1.327, dated 17 November 2026, can add an MCP server from JSON read on standard input, so tokens stay off the command line, according to its changelog.
text.es: Claude Code 2.1.327, del 17 de noviembre de 2026, puede añadir un servidor MCP desde un JSON leído por la entrada estándar, para que los tokens no queden en la línea de comandos, según su changelog.
text.ca: Claude Code 2.1.327, del 17 de novembre de 2026, pot afegir un servidor MCP des d'un JSON llegit per l'entrada estàndard, perquè els tokens no quedin a la línia d'ordres, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Kiro's changelog dated 17 November 2026 says enterprise administrators can require a sandbox for commands and local stdio MCP servers in Kiro IDE and Kiro CLI.
text.es: El changelog de Kiro del 17 de noviembre de 2026 dice que los administradores de empresa pueden exigir sandbox para comandos y servidores MCP stdio locales en Kiro IDE y Kiro CLI.
text.ca: El changelog de Kiro del 17 de novembre de 2026 diu que els administradors d'empresa poden exigir sandbox per a ordres i servidors MCP stdio locals a Kiro IDE i Kiro CLI.

text.en: CVE-2026-131857, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 in stdio-to-SSE mode can be crashed by unauthenticated requests with crafted sessionId values, according to NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-131857, en NVD el 18 de noviembre de 2026: Supergateway 4.2.0 a 4.2.2 en modo stdio-to-SSE puede caer con peticiones no autenticadas con valores sessionId manipulados, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-131857, a NVD el 18 de novembre de 2026: Supergateway 4.2.0 a 4.2.2 en mode stdio-to-SSE pot caure amb peticions no autenticades amb valors sessionId manipulats, segons NVD.

text.en: MAL-2026-20061, in OSV on 17 November 2026, lists the npm package vamp-mcp as malicious code, according to OSV.
text.es: MAL-2026-20061, en OSV el 17 de noviembre de 2026, registra el paquete npm vamp-mcp como código malicioso, según OSV.
text.ca: MAL-2026-20061, a OSV el 17 de novembre de 2026, registra el paquet npm vamp-mcp com a codi maliciós, segons OSV.

held.text_en: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.113, dated 17 November 2026, lets administrators disable built-in Browser Use with the managed setting features.browserUse, according to its changelog.

Qoder CN CLI 1.1.91, dated 17 November 2026, lets enterprise administrators distribute Skills and MCP to members, and Auto mode sends only high-risk commands to model approval, according to its changelog.
MAL-2026-20101, in OSV on 17 November 2026, lists the PyPI package agent-framework as malicious code, according to OSV.
MAL-2026-20068, in OSV on 17 November 2026, lists the PyPI package mcp-aevo-server as malicious code, according to OSV.
CVE-2026-130796, in NVD on 17 November 2026: Flowise 3.1.3 through 3.1.4 lets unauthenticated users read MCP server bearer tokens from a public chatflow endpoint, according to NVD.

CVE-2026-130121, in NVD on 18 November 2026: the AI Puffer MCP Server WordPress plugin up to 2.5.28 stores unsanitized AI-generated comment replies, allowing stored cross-site scripting, according to NVD.
Kiro Enterprise, in its changelog dated 16 November 2026, lets administrators stream each LLM request and completed tool call as a real-time OpenTelemetry event to their observability tools.

CVE-2026-68934 and GHSA-jq3q-62jc-fqq9, dated 16 November 2026: code-review-mcp-server before 1.5.3 runs folderPath and baseBranch parameters through a shell, allowing command injection, according to NVD.
MAL-2026-20009, in OSV on 16 November 2026, lists the npm package @shadowdu/memos-mcp as malicious code, according to OSV.
MAL-2026-20008, in OSV on 16 November 2026, lists the npm package @shadowdqj/image-mcp as malicious code, according to OSV.
CVE-2026-126681, in NVD on 16 November 2026: AWS Labs Timestream for InfluxDB MCP Server before 0.0.19 can disclose its InfluxDB API token to a crafted endpoint, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-126816, in NVD on 16 November 2026: AWS Pricing MCP Server before 1.0.31 can write report output outside its intended directory via path traversal, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-129235, in NVD on 16 November 2026: the download_file tool of kubeshark mcp from 53.1.0 until 53.4.0 writes to caller-chosen paths, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-129236, in NVD on 16 November 2026: the start_kubeshark tool of kubeshark mcp from 53.1.0 until 53.4.0 lets a pod_regex value be parsed as a Helm override, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-123142, in NVD on 17 November 2026: GitLab CE/EE let an MCP-scoped OAuth token change issue and merge request state, including merging, in several version ranges, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-129875, in NVD on 16 November 2026: REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 lets low-privileged users recover the administrator password hash through its MCP QueryRecords tool, according to NVD.
